name: 2S22 Bohdana

placement_rationale.text: Bohdana's own stated range of up to ~42 km with extended-range rounds means 14 km uses only about a third of its maximum reach, leaving a comfortable counter-battery survivability margin rather than sitting near max range with no room to displace. The wheeled 6x8/8x8 chassis exists specifically to exploit that margin, firing and relocating rather than trading mobility for a few extra kilometers of standoff. 14 km sits inside doctrine.md §2's 10–150+ km medium/long-range strike layer while staying clear of the close-in 0–10 km FPV strike zone that most threatens a static gun position. (Nudged 14→13.6 km from this category's shared round-number value so it doesn't literally coincide with side_a-artillery-caesar-155mm-self-propelled-gun on the map's distance axis — a small, deterministic spread within the same band, not a new plausibility claim beyond what's already argued above.)

characteristics: range up to ~42km with extended-range rounds
Strength: Domestically produced, so not dependent on foreign donation pipelines or export approval; wheeled mobility supports rapid displacement
Limitation: Domestic production volume is smaller than the scale of donated Western systems; specific performance figures are less independently verified than donated NATO equipment
Estimated quantity available: Production ongoing; total fielded not publicly disclosed
employment_notes: Ukraine's first mass-produced domestic modern SPG, symbolically and practically important as a hedge against donor-dependency for artillery
contrast_vs_traditional: Bohdana is Ukraine's own wartime answer to the same problem Caesar solves for its NATO donors: a wheeled chassis built specifically to displace faster than a drone-cued counter-battery response, produced domestically because doctrine.md's minutes-scale kill chain finding made dwell-time survivability a requirement no import pipeline could guarantee fast enough on its own.
